purpose: Teach: ミッキー/ウィリアムズ/クック/ヘレン/ダビデ/ケイト/トミー/メリー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ディズニーのミッキー・マウスがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she mentioned our customer really loves Mickey Mouse.
lines.style: Warm, slightly amused observation. Soft voice, like sharing a small discovered detail. Gentle pacing, almost conspiratorial — the kind thing one friend tells another about someone they both care for noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、テニスのウィリアムズ姉妹のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she mentioned our customer's a big fan of the Williams sisters.
lines.style: Matching Mei's tone, mirroring the same gentle observation. A shared smile underneath. Quiet recognition of learning something new about a regular. Pace stays calm, unhurried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米アップルのクックCEOの講演を聴かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she mentioned our customer went to hear Tim Cook give a lecture.
lines.style: Same reflective warmth continues. Eyes brightening slightly at the image of their customer seeking out something so specific. Voice stays low, intimate — the accumulation of small knowings.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、女優のヘレン・ミレンがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she mentioned our customer absolutely adores Helen Mirren.
lines.style: The pattern holding steady. A little more colour in the voice now — genuine delight at learning what matters to someone. Still conversational, never performing. Breath underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ダビデ像の芸術論を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she mentioned our customer shared this whole thoughtful piece about Michelangelo's David.
lines.style: Slight lift of amazement now — the realization that this customer opens up, shares depth. Slower, savouring the detail. Like Mei is still turning this over in her mind. Tender note underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国ケイト妃のファッションがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she mentioned our customer loves Kate's style — the Princess's fashion sense.
lines.style: Returning to the gentler pace. A knowing half-smile in the voice — there's a elegance to this detail that Aoi would recognise too. No rush. Building the portrait together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、トミー・ヒルフィガーのお洋服がお好みだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she mentioned our customer has such a good eye for Tommy Hilfiger pieces.
lines.style: Voice warm but reflective, almost wistful. The recognition that taste is a kind of intimacy. Slower breath. Slight trailing at the end, like Mei is thinking beyond what she's saying.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メリー・ポピンズの映画を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she mentioned our customer lit up talking about Mary Poppins.
lines.style: Quieter now, more held. The closing note of something — like Mei is sitting with the image of their customer's joy. Slower pace. Tender exhale at the end, letting the moment settle.
